MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Anker USB hub felt useful because it could let me connect my recent USB Ethernet adapter alongside other USB accessories.",
    "The hub also fits my earlier USB expansion purchase: both address connecting peripherals to a computer."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The hard drives, SSD and memory card assume a storage need that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The streaming stick and smart speaker do not help with the computer connections I have been buying accessories for.",
    "The HDMI and coaxial cables serve different connections from my DVI cable and USB Ethernet adapter; being cables does not make them useful substitutes.",
    "The battery backup could fit a desktop setup, but I have no immediate need for one."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any computer upgrade.",
    "My networking and cable purchases seem to have been treated as interest in cables generally, without enough attention to what they connect."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase was a USB Ethernet adapter, making accessories that help me use USB connections more relevant.",
    "My purchases are occasional and serve specific purposes; I would need a concrete use before choosing another accessory.",
    "Connection type and compatibility matter more to me than whether two products belong to the same broad electronics group."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The USB hub matched my practical connectivity needs, but most suggestions assumed broader upgrade or entertainment interests that my purchases do not establish."
}
